research.title: Surface Defect Classification Under Variable Lighting
bullets: Prepared labeled surface image datasets by checking annotation consistency, standardizing image dimensions, and separating training and evaluation samples by source specimen.
Implemented assigned histogram and texture feature baselines with support vector classifiers, inspecting confusion matrices across lighting conditions and documenting recurring classification errors.

work.title: Inventory Records and Shipment Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory logs, checked incoming delivery paperwork against purchase records, and referred quantity discrepancies to the appropriate staff for resolution.
Coordinated routine shipment scheduling, organized dispatch documents, and followed up on outstanding orders with suppliers and internal operations staff.

projects.title: Handwritten Digit Recognition with Classical Classifiers
bullets: Implemented nearest neighbor and logistic regression baselines for handwritten digit classification using normalized pixel arrays and a predefined training and test split.
Compared classifier predictions through confusion matrices and inspected misclassified images to document ambiguities associated with stroke thickness, slant, and digit shape.
